description: Fork of exp166 (Q/K MLP h=2048, val_bpb=1.7162 vs exp154=1.7105). Replace v_lut LUT with per-head V MLP using identical structure: Linear(64,2048,bias=False) → GELU → Linear(2048,32,bias=False) → LayerNorm(32). d_v=32 kept. v_lut params drop from 75.5M (12.6M/layer × 6) to 7.1M (1.18M/layer × 6) — saves 68.4M. Total budget ~116M (was 184M for exp166, 392M for exp154). Tests whether V's role can be served by an MLP — out_proj remains LUT-based.
